title: Freeze Out
description: A first-person snowball fight: four against four with bots across eight winter maps, from an alpine village to an ice rink. It has three game modes and tournament cups, and no ads.
how_to_play: Works with keyboard and mouse, touch or a gamepad. Click or tap to throw a snowball, and hold to wind up a longer throw. Choose Quick match to jump in, or Training to practise first.
